proof_body:
by
  intro a b c
  have h1 : (b + c).choose b * b.factorial * c.factorial = (b + c).factorial := by
    have := Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial c b
    rwa [add_comm c b, mul_right_comm] at this
  have h2 : (a + (b + c)).choose a * a.factorial * (b + c).factorial = (a + (b + c)).factorial := by
    have := Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (b + c) a
    rwa [add_comm (b + c) a, mul_right_comm] at this
  rw [add_assoc a b c, ← h2, ← h1]
  ring
target_source: ∀ a b c : ℕ, a.factorial * b.factorial * c.factorial * ((a + b + c).choose a * (b + c).choose b) = (a + b + c).factorial
